recipe.visualDefinition: A symmetrical composition featuring a group portrait framed within a dark rectangular cutout, set against a large, translucent blue pyramid with glowing neon edges and cross-shaped lens flares.
coreVisualRelationships: Central group portrait framed by a dark void within a larger geometric structure
High-contrast lighting on subjects against a deep, monochromatic blue environment
Diagonal neon light bar cutting across the foreground to connect subjects
Symmetrical placement of display typography in the top corners
coreInvariants: Four-pointed star lens flares on structural edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects positioned waist-up in the lower-center, occupying roughly 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The apex of the blue pyramid at the top-center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top pyramid point down the glowing edges to the central group, then across the diagonal neon bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanses of flat blue in the upper corners provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cobalt and Royal Blue (background and structural elements)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric Cyan and White (neon glow and lens flares)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues with high-value white highlights creating a 'glowing' effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid warm tones like red or orange
Limit palette to blues, blacks, and whites

letterConstructionRules: Mirroring of specific characters to create symmetry
characterSpecificRedesigns: One 'B' is horizontally mirrored to face left
Letters are tightly packed to touch or nearly touch

composition.position: Top left and top right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniformity; use the same typeface family for both corner elements to maintain balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric purity and ability to handle tight kerning well

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a symmetrical image of a large blue translucent pyramid with glowing cyan edges and star-shaped lens flares. In the center, place a dark rectangular opening containing a group of four people in 1970s formal attire. A diagonal neon blue light bar should cross the foreground.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place bold white geometric sans-serif text in the top left and top right corners. Mirror the second letter of the left-hand word horizontally.

verificationChecks: Are there four-pointed star flares on the pyramid edges?
Is the background a consistent monochromatic blue?
Is the text justified to the top corners?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the central frame
Angle of the foreground neon bar
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical balance between the two text blocks
Ensure the neon bar appears to be held by the subjects
Verify the pyramid apex is perfectly centered
Confirm the lens flares are four-pointed and sharp
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Frame + Monochromatic Blue + Neon Accents + Mirrored Sans-Serif Typography
